image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a bright green snake (Green Mamba) draped over thin branches. The head is raised and facing right, displaying vivid emerald green coloration with smooth, glossy scales. The eye is large, dark, and round. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/brown, suggesting an arboreal setting. The tail and ventral surface are not visible in the frame.
